title: The Download: OpenAI unveils GPT-Red and heat pumps rise in the US
raw_excerpt: This is today’s edition of The Download , our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. Meet GPT-Red: an LLM super-hacker OpenAI built to make its models safer OpenAI has built an LLM super-hacker called GPT-Red that it uses as a sparring partner to help its other models boost their defenses against cyberattacks. It automates a type of safety evaluation for software systems known as red-teaming, which is typically done by a team of human testers. The aim is to find as many different ways to break or hijack a system as possible. OpenAI gave MIT Technology Review an exclusive peek into the system. Find out how it could keep the company ahead of human attackers . —Will Douglas Heaven Why heat pumps are still so hot in the US —Casey Crownhart It feels as if it should be illegal to even think about heating appliances during the height of summer, but we need to talk about heat pumps. The appliances use electricity for heating, they’re incredibly efficient, and they’re on the rise. In the US, their sales have doubled over the past 15 years, according to a new report. They’re also winning the heating race against fossil fuels, outpacing natural-gas furnaces by 32% during the first quarter of 2026. These stats are especially striking at this moment, because a key tax credit for heat pumps just ended. So why are heat pumps still so hot? Read the full story for the answer . This article is from The Spark, our weekly climate tech newsle…
summary: OpenAI 构建了一个名为 GPT-Red 的 LLM 超级黑客，用于自动化红队测试，帮助其他模型提升防御网络攻击的能力。它通过迭代生成对抗性提示来暴露模型漏洞，并将攻击纳入训练后，使 GPT-5.6 Sol 在提示注入基准测试中的失败率降低了六倍。这标志着 AI 安全评估从人工向自动化的重要转变。

title: Thinking Machines Releases First Open Model
raw_excerpt: Thinking Machines has released Inkling, a 975B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 41B active parameters, multimodal reasoning, and a one-million-token context window. The model was made available for customization through Tinker alongside a smaller preview version.
summary: Thinking Machines 发布了其首个开放权重模型 Inkling，这是一个 9750 亿参数的混合专家模型，拥有 410 亿活跃参数、多模态推理能力和 100 万 token 的上下文窗口。该模型可通过 Tinker 平台进行定制，并附带一个较小的预览版本。这是开源模型领域的重要进展，挑战了闭源模型的领先地位。

title: 独家 | 智谱 ARR 达到10 亿美元，半年增长 15 倍
raw_excerpt: 文 | 周鑫雨 编辑 | 张雨忻 智能涌现从多个独立信源处获悉， 截至 2026 年 7 月， 智谱的 ARR（年度经常性收入）已经达到 10 亿美元 。 截至发稿前，针对上述信息，智谱未回复。 过去一年，AI Coding 和视频生成模型已经成为全球造血能力最强的 AI 赛道。 海外，Anthropic 的 Claude Code 仅发布半年，ARR 就飙升至 10 亿美金。这一现金牛产品，也将 Anthropic 的整体 估值抬高到万亿美金（2026 年 5 月），超过了 OpenAI。 但此前，对于国内大模型公司能否复刻 Anthropic 的财富神话，市场一直抱有疑问。一方面，背靠企业付费意愿高、订阅生态成熟的北美市场，Anthropic 有天然优渥的商业化土壤。另一方面，Anthropic 的估值，与智谱最新市值仍存在一个数量级的差距——这意味着，Anthropic 有更大量的资金能获取训练资源，这是国内模型厂商还比不了的。 但智谱达到 10 亿美金 ARR 的速度，远超预期。曾有投资人对我们表示，智谱的 ARR 预计到 2026 年底，才能达到 10 亿-15 亿美金。 一个更直观的对比是：根据Anthropic 的官方数据和智谱财报数据，ARR 从 1 亿美金增长到 10 亿美金，Anthropic 用了 15 个月，智谱仅用了 5 个月。 据知情人士，在2026 年 1 月到7 月期间，智谱的 ARR 增长了 15 倍。 智谱是国内最早押注 Coding 路线的模型厂商之一。2025年初，智谱就开始将力量收敛到了对模型 Coding 能力的提升上。智谱创始人唐杰曾形容智谱押注了 Coding 和 Reasoning——一种能与 Agent 共生共荣的模型能力。 后续，智谱以平均两个月一版的速度，发布了一系列 Coding 能力位于全球第一梯队的旗舰模型。2026 年 6 月最新上线的 GLM-5.2，即便开源，多个核心指标依然追平甚至超过了 Claude Opus 4.8 以及 GPT-5.5。 智谱官方曾提到， 大模型的商业价值可以理解为 “ 智能上限 × Token 消耗规模 ”，只要模型能力继续领先，调用量就会不断增长。财报显示， 今年 Q1，GLM 的 API 价格累计调高约 83%，海外订阅价格甚至接近 Claude Code，但调用量仍增长约 400%。 在用 Token 消耗衡量模型商业化水平的当下，Coding 和视频生成模型代表了两种范式：前者为企业和开发者直接提供生产力，后者则是进入到了工业化内容生产的核心环节。 从营收数据上看，Coding 的市场需求已经走向确定，视频生成也是。据智能涌现了解，Seedance2.0 的月营收接近 10 亿元；而高盛预测，可灵 AI 的 ARR 到年底能达到 10 亿美金。 不过，确定性的生意，也意味着更激烈的竞争。6 月，MiniMax 发布了 M3，重点强化了 Coding 和 Agent 能力。7 月 16 日，月之暗面也发布了 K3，一个参数量 达 2.8 万亿、综合智力水平仅次于 Claude Fable 5 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 的开源模型。 就连海外，随着 GPT-5.6 的发布、ChatGPT 与 CodeX 的合并，OpenAI 在 Coding 领域，也显示出��逆袭 Anthropic 的势头。 在当下这个时间点，Coding 之战还远未结束。
summary: 据多个独立信源，截至 2026 年 7 月，智谱的年度经常性收入（ARR）已达到 10 亿美元，从 1 亿到 10 亿仅用 5 个月，速度超过 Anthropic 的 15 个月。这一里程碑表明国内大模型公司的商业化能力正在快速追赶海外巨头，AI Coding 和视频生成成为主要造血赛道。

title: Google ordered to open Android and Search to rivals in Europe
raw_excerpt: Google must give rival AI assistants and search engines greater access to key parts of Android and Google Search after the European Union ordered the company to comply with the bloc's digital antitrust rules. The two decisions , handed down Thursday, could weaken Google's control over two of the tech industry's most important platforms and have far-reaching consequences for the company, shape the future of its AI tool Gemini, and open up new opportunities for rivals to gain ground. Google has until January 2027 to begin sharing search data and July 2027 to implement changes to Android. The rulings stem from technical regulatory proceedings … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 欧盟正式命令 Google 向竞争对手开放 Android 和搜索数据，要求 Google 在 2027 年前共享搜索数据并开放 Android 上的 AI 功能。这一决定可能削弱 Google 对两大核心平台的控制，为 rival AI 助手和搜索引擎创造新机会，并对 Gemini 等 AI 工具的未来产生深远影响。

title: The first experimental evidence of recursive self-improvement
raw_excerpt: Researchers used autoresearch on an autoresearch agent over eight days. The results beat the harness they hand-tuned for two years. The fully autonomous system had an inner loop that optimized code against an eval and an outer loop that optimized the inner-loop agent's harness code against the inner loop's average score across different benchmarks. It designed a novel search algorithm, reduced prompt size by 16x, and built a layered system against reward hacking.
summary: 研究人员首次通过实验证明了递归自我改进：一个自动研究代理在八天内自主优化自身代码，击败了团队手工调优两年的系统。它设计出新颖的搜索算法，将提示大小缩减 16 倍，并构建了多层防奖励黑客机制。这一成果为 AI 自主进化提供了实证基础。

title: Claude can now use your 1Password credentials for you
raw_excerpt: 1Password has launched a new browser integration for Claude that allows the Anthropic chatbot to access stored security credentials like usernames and passwords. The 1Password for Claude feature means that users can authorize Claude to complete multi-step tasks like booking travel and managing online accounts on their behalf without having to manually input their login credentials, but without actually exposing security information to Anthropic's AI models, according to 1Password. That's made possible by a new "zero-exposure security framework" developed by 1Password, which works by injecting the required credentials for each task through a … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 1Password 推出了针对 Claude 的浏览器集成，允许用户授权 Claude 访问存储的凭据以自动完成多步骤任务（如预订旅行），同时通过“零暴露安全框架”确保凭据不暴露给 Anthropic 的 AI 模型。这解决了 AI 代理安全使用敏感信息的核心痛点。

title: NVIDIA Expanded Jetson Thor for Edge Robotics
raw_excerpt: NVIDIA introduced the Blackwell-powered Jetson Thor T3000 and T2000 modules for running robotics, visual AI, and agent workloads on compact edge systems. The platform had already attracted adoption from companies including Amazon Robotics, Boston Dynamics, FANUC, and 1X.
summary: NVIDIA 推出了基于 Blackwell 架构的 Jetson Thor T3000 和 T2000 模块，专为边缘机器人、视觉 AI 和代理工作负载设计。该平台已被 Amazon Robotics、Boston Dynamics、FANUC 和 1X 等公司采用，标志着边缘 AI 计算能力的重要升级。

title: Grok Build Coding Agent (GitHub Repo)
raw_excerpt: Grok Build is a terminal-based coding agent that can inspect codebases, edit files, run shell commands, search the web, and manage long-running tasks. It supports interactive use, headless scripting and CI, and editor integration through the Agent Client Protocol.
summary: xAI 开源了 Grok Build，一个基于终端的编码代理，能够检查代码库、编辑文件、运行 shell 命令、搜索网页并管理长时间运行的任务。它支持交互式使用、无头脚本和 CI，并通过 Agent Client Protocol 集成编辑器。这是 AI 编码工具领域的重要开源贡献。

title: Google is renaming NotebookLM to Gemini Notebook
raw_excerpt: Google is giving its AI note-taking app a new name. The company announced on Thursday that NotebookLM is becoming Gemini Notebook, but will remain a standalone app even as it integrates more deeply across Gemini and Google Search. Google first revealed Gemini Notebook - then called Project Tailwind - in May 2023 before widely releasing the app just months later . Over the past few years, Google has been adding new features to the app to help organize and make sense of your notes, such as the ability to summarize them as AI podcasts , narrated slideshows , and TikTok-style clips . It recently started letting users connect their notebooks to the  … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Google 宣布将 NotebookLM 更名为 Gemini Notebook，但保留其独立应用形态，同时更深入地整合 Gemini 和 Google 搜索。该应用已具备 AI 播客、幻灯片和短视频摘要等功能。更名反映了 Google 统一 AI 品牌战略，但可能影响原有用户认知。
